You can also debug directly against your phone - all phones Android 2.2 and above should have this framework installed. Overview ====== GPSLogger is composed of a few main components; ### Event Bus The Event Bus is where all the cross communication happens. Various components raise their events on the Event Bus, and other parts of the application listen for those events.
